usage: Protocol reference only. The front-end TypeScript parsers and caller-transport request orchestration reuse Node Comics code; upstream Kotlin/APK code is not executed or bundled.
scope: Public HTML name search for WebtoonScan; read-only madara_load_more content-search POST pagination for LHTranslation, Mangasushi, Manga Eclipse, Bun Manga, Monopoly Scan, GakaMangas, Hunlight Comics, Anisa Scans and S2Manga / S2READ, verified against their live endpoints; static ungrouped and manga-scoped AJAX chapter lists; verified chapter-canonical/static-select, chapter-canonical/AJAX-select (including the repeated breadcrumb picker and fully server-populated holders), explicit AJAX navigation with owned breadcrumb chapter titles, and catalog-canonical/static-select reader identities; contiguous image-N page slots. Other upstream Madara modules are not registered or claimed compatible.
